passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.text: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Thundering Smash
spells.text: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

spells.name: Frenzied Maul
spells.text: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

spells.name: Sky Splitter
spells.text: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

spells.name: Stormbringer
spells.text: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

damage.value: Volibear deals sustained bonus magic damage with his Attacks after building Passive stacks.

archetype.value: Volibear is a bruiser with both AD and AP-focused build options.

axis.value: Volibear clears waves with his passive and items to keep earning gold.

winCondition.value: Volibear wins by clearing waves for gold, then using his ultimate to reach and kill the enemy backline.

spikes.why: Volibear can reach the enemy backline in teamfights.

bait.why: Volibear loses his speed toward enemies and his next-Attack Stun while Q is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Volibear misses W's bonus damage and Heal by casting it on a different target instead of the marked one.
